'''Football Club Suhareka''' ({{langx|sq|Klubi Futbollistik Suhareka}}), commonly known as '''Suhareka''', is a [[Football team|football club]] based in [[Suva Reka]], [[Kosovo]]. The club plays in the [[Football Superleague of Kosovo|Superleague of Kosovo]], which is the top tier of football in the country."}}
